onboarding.title: What is happening here
body: You are getting to know the game: boop the pet, sort into boxes, and scratch a coin ticket.
Three boxes: Needs — essentials, Wants — nice things, Savings — for a goal.
You cannot fail. Any step can be retried, nothing will be lost.

home.title: Main Screen
body: Here you see the pet, coins, savings jar, and what the pet is currently doing.
Coins come from chores and tasks. Each income shows where it came from.
Tap «?» on any screen — I will tell you what to do there.

uiKit.title: Developer Screen
body: This is a component showcase: buttons, cards, meters, and sheets in all states.
It helps the team test the UI, and is not part of the game storyline.

ui-kit.title: Developer Screen
body: This is a component showcase: buttons, cards, meters, and sheets in all states.
It helps the team test the UI, and is not part of the game storyline.

period-summary.title: Period totals
body: We compare plan and fact across three directions: needs, wants, savings.
If more went somewhere — those coins did not vanish, they went somewhere else.
Next comes a recovery screen: pick one gentle step for the next period. Progress is never wiped.

recovery.title: Recovery path
body: After the totals you pick one or two concrete steps for the next period.
The options depend on what went off plan — save first, wait on a want, protect needs.
You can skip. Nothing is wiped and nothing is graded.

shop.title: Shop
body: The street has four shops: grocery, clothes, furniture and toys. Each has its own shelf.
A purchase spends coins and updates the period fact — so the plan can be compared with real life.
If you do not have enough coins, I will say exactly how many are missing and three options: earn, take from the jar, or wait. You cannot go below zero. Toys will get mini-games later.

savings.title: Savings jar
body: There are three goals here. Pick one — it shows on the home screen.
You can put coins in during any active period: they leave the wallet, fill the jar and update the savings fact.
Taking coins out opens a confirm screen: I recalculate how much is left to the goal and roughly how many periods. Not a ban — just the price of the choice.

tasks.title: Tasks
body: Six chores across three themes: planning, savings and payments.
There are quizzes, a shopping basket, need-before-want order, change counting and a dialog — not only tests.
A miss does not wipe progress: the chore still pays part of the coins and names the rule.
